# PendingMessageHandler

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.handlers.PendingMessageHandler`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(callback: Callable, filters = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The PendingMessage handler class. Used to handle pending messages: drafts of messages that bots stream
into private chats. It is intended to be used with [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md).

For a nicer way to register this handler, have a look at the
[`on_pending_message`](../decorators/on_pending_message.md) decorator.

### Parameters

- **`callback`** (`Callable`)
  Pass a function that will be called when a bot sends a new version of a pending message. It takes
  *(client, pending_message)* as positional arguments (look at the section below for a detailed
  description).

- **`filters`** (`Filters`)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of updates to be passed in your callback function.

Other parameters:
    client (`Client`):
        The Client itself, useful when you want to call other API methods inside the handler.

    pending_message ([`PendingMessage`](../types/messages_and_media/PendingMessage.md)):
        The pending message. It replaces any pending message with the same draft_id and must be removed
        when a message or a pending message with another draft_id arrives.

_Source: `pyrogram/handlers/pending_message_handler.py`._
